pages.text: Upgrade augments improve the overall stats of machines, devices, dynamos, and tools; they scale the base RF storage/transfer, fluid storage/transfer, and RF/t usage/generation. Their scale factors multiply with each other and with compatible augment modifiers.

Hardened, Reinforced, and Resonant Integral Components have scale factors of 2x, 4x, and 8x respectively. Installing all three produces a combined 64x base scale before other compatible augment modifiers are applied.
